note: Identifiers only. Event flow locations of the remake matched to OoTR locations. conf: item, scene or guess. support: supported means one replacement of the named event parameters is expected to work, unsupported means the flow needs extra care and the build refuses it.

sources.ootr: LocationList.py of the OoT Randomizer (MIT), types Song, Boss, Cutscene, NPC and Event without Master Quest
sources.snapshots: items.json 21074 bytes and locations.json 383400 bytes, copied at the start of the run

conf_help.item: the flow grants the actor that matches the OoTR vanilla item and the flow identifies the location
conf_help.scene: the flow, NPC or entry name identifies the location, the item is common or only matches by class
conf_help.guess: the flow is the best candidate but the item or the path does not match cleanly

Events 71 and 91 of MiniGame_FrogTenors are the remake's insect repellent game (MiniGame_FrogTenors_InsectRepellent flags, MushiToriGame), not the rain game, and event 247 is the reward of the six song ocarina game (it runs after MiniGame_FrogTenors_SongClear), so it stays ZR Frogs Ocarina Game. Checked in the flow dump 2026-11-11, the rain game has no flow event of its own
